title: Mo' Tools Mod
description: Adds More Tools Made Of Materials That Make Sense As Tools!
body:
# **Mo' Tools Mod**


The Mo' Tools Mod adds in over 110+ tools to your Minecraft world along with upgrades to make your tools even better. Check out the Mod Showcase below for an in-game look of the mod!

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/maehicUSl7w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## **Features**
- Adds 110 base tools which can all be upgraded
  - Andesite
  - Diorite
  - Granite
  - Netherrack
  - End Stone
  - Glass
  - Lapis Lazuli
  - Amethyst
  - Emerald
  - Echo
  - Copper
  - Obsidian
  - Redstone
  - Coal
  - Sandstone
  - Red Sandstone
  - Terracotta
  - Tuff
  - Quartz

## 
- Adds 7 upgrades 4 of which can be applied to all tools
  - Blaze Upgrade
  - Spider Upgrade
  - Star Upgrade
  - Lapis Upgrade
  - Quartz Upgrade
  - Redstone Upgrade
  - Obsidian Upgrade

## 
- Adds nuggets to smelt down added tools
  - Netherite Nugget
  - Diamond Nugget
  - Emerald Nugget
  - Lapis Nugget
  - Copper Nugget
  - Amethyst Nugget
  - Echo Nugget
  - Obsidian Nugget

## **Upgrades**
**Blaze Upgrade**

The Blaze Upgrade is applied to only Diamond tools when put into a smithing table. Blaze Tools can set mobs on fire, which is helpful for getting cooked meat fast and easy. The Blaze Tools can also smelt the blocks they mind, for exmple, Stone -> Smooth Stone, Logs -> Charcoal, Clay -> Terracotta, and more!

![Blaze Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a21ac1866900ead001d451f8f1bd131f3a397639.png)

_Blaze Upgrade needs Blaze Powder to combine with Diamond Tools_
## 

**Spider Upgrade**

The Spider Upgrade is applied to only Iron Tools when put into a smithing table. Spider Tools can give mobs the poison effect, which lasts for a few seconds. They can also freeze mobs in place for a second like they are stuck in a web.

![Spider Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/911297a5bca18b053e29be6a9153f99c9d5d428d.png)

_Spider Upgrade needs Spider Eye to combine with Iron Tools_
## 

**Star Upgrade**

The Star Upgrade is applied to only Diamond Tools when put into a smithing table. Star Tools are more powerful Diamond Tools, with increased attack speed and damage.

![Star Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9f354c3f117b214b7a84b575e7690afffce48e4.png)

_Star Upgrade needs Neather Star to combine with Diamond Tools_
## 

**Lapis Upgrade**

The Lapis Upgrade is applied to all tools, except Star Tools, when put into a smithing table. Tools with the Lapis Upgrade are givin increased enchantablity, which inreases the chance of getting multiple good enchantments on the tools.

![Lapis Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d879e36dbfe74232ef710df9f3ee91bc1aa4e7a3.png)

_Lapis Upgrade needs Lapis Lazuli to combine with Tools_
## 

**Quartz Upgrade**

The Quartz Upgrade is applied to all tools, except Star Tools, when put into a smithing table. Tools with the Quartz Upgrade are givin increased attack speed.

![Quartz Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df4191741e9b16557c19ad29949a600b9819e51d.png)

_Quartz Upgrade needs Quartz to combine with Tools_
## 

**Redstone Upgrade**

The Redstone Upgrade is applied to all tools, except Star Tools, when put into a smithing table. Tools with the Redstone Upgrade are givin increase efficiency, which makes your tools mine faster then normal.

![Redstone Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9083c9e761c15ea42ab3cc5b26f5b9b0fa3ac996.png)

_Redstone Upgrade needs Redstone Dust to combine with Tools_
## 

**Obsidian Upgrade**

The Obsidian Upgrade is applied to all tools, except Star Tools, when put into a smithing table. Tools with the Obsidian Upgrade are givin double the durability, multipling the base durability of the tool by two.

![Obsidian Upgrade Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/268a9d9830abb988d721ecb4a7daa16489f32e77.png)

_Obsidian Upgrade needs Obsidian to combine with Tools_
